final_system.candidate_layer: faithful IKSel: CVT-sampled table (201,600 entries, Lloyd on 2M pool, seed 20260738), key (pos/0.05, tool-z), per task 32 cone directions (29.5 deg), k=200 query, full-6D Jacobian rerank (top-20), DLS with farthest-from-tried reshuffle retries (max 4), strict validation, dedup 0.08 rad; classical q0_pilot fallback slot; fully self-contained, no experiment data, no train-task exclusion needed
final_system.selector: 5-member SetSel (unchanged recipe), 45-D features, trained on the 20,000-task iksel-pool return tables labeled under HYBRID
final_system.deployment: one table query + one selector forward + one seed + one rollout; 0 probes

training_tasks.composition: 18,432 historical train split + 1,568 fresh top-up tasks
training_tasks.topup_exclusions: rank_train(+b,c), external_dev_v1, final_holdout v1/v2 via builder; systematic-10k extra audit

win_criterion: IKSel is the sole mainline; no external baseline. The enumeration+its-own-hybrid-selector arm is an internal candidate-layer ABLATION: parity or better at ~1/3 solve budget = pass. Within-pool references: first-feasible, oracle (diagnostic).

selector_multiseed.publish_rule: median of mean progress across validation+external among run seeds; ties toward lower seed; frozen before sealed read

sealed_v3.note: generated only after selector publication; exclusions = all prior caches incl. top-up; single read
